shared.closeTitleHtml: From national payment rails to global trust infrastructure.
closeHtml: RS IntelliEdge™ is built on infrastructure principles proven at national scale. It brings together payment operators, banks, and institutions on a single intelligence platform—eliminating blind spots and enabling real-time, ecosystem-wide fraud prevention without compromising participant privacy or data sovereignty.

regions.introTitleHtml: RS IntelliEdge™ is RS Software's AI/ML-driven fraud and risk platform
regions.introHtml:
RS IntelliEdge™ is RS Software's AI/ML-driven fraud and risk management solution designed for real-time protection of digital payments. It adapts to evolving threats, ensuring secure, intelligent monitoring across all transaction types. Whether you're managing national payment systems or banking operations, RS IntelliEdge™ has you covered.

Explore the RS IntelliEdge™ portfolio and find the right fraud and risk management solution for your organization.

tabs.label: For Bank
tabs.titleHtml: Built for banks to protect customers in real time.
parasHtml: Fraud no longer stays within a single channel. RS IntelliEdge™ gives banks a unified view of risk across transactions, customers, devices, and payment channels, combining AI/ML, behavioural analytics, and rules to detect threats before funds leave the account.
From APP fraud and account takeovers to mule activity and emerging fraud patterns, banks can respond at payment speed while keeping legitimate customer journeys moving.
tabs.whyTitleHtml: Real-time fraud intelligence across every payment journey.
whyParasHtml: RS IntelliEdge™ helps banks assess transaction risk as payments happen, combining AI/ML, behavioural analytics, rules and ecosystem intelligence. It supports fraud detection across real-time payments, cards, A2A, wallets, and other digital payment channels, helping identify emerging fraud patterns while enabling explainable decisions and a more continuous view of customer and transaction risk.

caps.descHtml: AI-driven scoring delivers instant risk assessment for early fraud intervention and faster decisioning.
Monitor fraud across mobile, internet, ATM, branch and other payment channels from a unified intelligence layer.
Combine transaction, behavioural, device and identity signals to detect unusual customer activity.
Identify authorised push payment fraud, account takeovers and mule activity using behavioural and AI-powered pattern recognition.
Give fraud teams human-readable explanations behind risk decisions and audit-ready trails.
Train, test, monitor and adapt fraud models as threat patterns change.
Support investigation, transaction search, case handling, entity-link analysis, and AML workflows in one environment.
Integrate with existing banking and payment infrastructure without requiring a complete technology overhaul.

tabs.label: For Central
tabs.titleHtml: Built for payment ecosystems that cannot afford blind spots.
parasHtml: Real-time payment networks operate across multiple rails, participants, and transaction types. RS IntelliEdge™ creates a unified fraud intelligence layer that helps central infrastructures detect risk across the ecosystem, not just within individual participants.

It combines real-time scoring, behavioural intelligence, AI/ML, rules, and federated learning to identify emerging threats while giving participating institutions the visibility and controls needed to act quickly.
tabs.whyTitleHtml: A unified intelligence layer for the global real-time payments ecosystem.
whyParasHtml: RS IntelliEdge™ brings real-time fraud, risk and AML intelligence across payment networks and rails, combining AI/ML, behavioural analytics, rules and federated learning. It helps central infrastructures and payment ecosystems identify emerging fraud patterns, strengthen cross-rail intelligence and support fast, explainable and actionable risk decisions at payment speed.

caps.descHtml: Score transactions in under 100ms and apply intelligence across multiple payment rails and transaction types.
Connect fraud signals across participating institutions to identify patterns that may remain invisible within individual systems.
Provide human-readable explanations and audit-ready trails for risk decisions, investigation and governance.
Create, test, simulate and deploy rules across payment rails without waiting for engineering cycles.
Enable shared fraud intelligence while keeping participant customer data within its own environment.
Monitor model drift, support model refresh and manage evolving fraud models over time.
Bring investigation, transaction search, entity-link analysis, AML assistance and audit-ready trails into one platform.
Connect with existing payment infrastructure through unified, rail-agnostic APIs.

tabs.label: For Bank

parasHtml: Instant and A2A payments can settle in seconds, leaving limited time to react after a transaction is initiated. RS IntelliEdge™ brings continuous risk assessment into the payment flow, using behavioural, device and contextual signals to help identify APP scams, account takeover and identity-led threats.
Through the ChainIT alliance, the intelligence layer can work alongside existing fraud systems while the financial institution retains control of the final action.

Through the ChainIT alliance, this intelligence can work alongside existing fraud tools for A2A payments, helping surface the risk, the reason behind the decision and an auditable record while allowing the financial institution to retain control over the final action.
